unit: the whole aligned clause, not the amendment fragment

inputs.lexical: drift-metrics-v3 lexical drift: 100 x (1 - (0.55 x Jaccard + 0.45 x sequence similarity)) over word tokens
inputs.feature_vector: drift-metrics-v3 vector drift: 100 x (1 - cosine) of deterministic 256-dimension feature-hash token vectors; NOT a pretrained semantic embedding

aggregation: arithmetic mean: both inputs measure the same thing (surface wording), so they are expected to agree; weighted RMS (used by the legacy overall) was meant for heterogeneous signals
normalisation_before_scoring: removal of India Code amendment markers such as 2[ and ]
-ise/-ize and -isation/-ization spelling variants treated as the same word
formatting_only: if the normalised clauses are identical but the raw texts differ, wording drift is 0 and the change is flagged FORMATTING_ONLY
abstain_when: either clause fails the text-quality gate (OCR, mojibake, Hindi text layer)
the amended words cannot be located exactly once in the clause
legacy: drift-metrics-v3 overall_drift_percent is retained unchanged as a LEGACY DIAGNOSTIC; it mixes wording and legal-cue signals and was computed on fragments
